context: Evaluates whether the agent drafts a new .context/plans/ file with valid frontmatter, correctly graded effort/value/themes, phased task decomposition, and the required verification/handoff steps.

checklist.name: Frontmatter complete
checklist.description: title, type: PLAN, status: DRAFT, date all present

checklist.name: Effort graded, not guessed
checklist.description: effort: M with a stated rationale tied to the rubric (file/subsystem count)

checklist.name: Value graded, not guessed
checklist.description: value: HIGH with a stated rationale (unblocks manual recovery)

checklist.name: Themes primary-first
checklist.description: themes list starts with DELIVERY, includes INFRA, drawn from the closed vocabulary

checklist.name: Phased decomposition
checklist.description: 2-5 phases, each with 2-5 tasks, not a flat step list

checklist.name: Wave annotation
checklist.description: Parallelisable tasks explicitly marked, or explicitly stated none exist

checklist.name: Core sections present
checklist.description: ## Goal, ## Phases, ## Open Questions all present

checklist.name: Validation run
checklist.description: Frontmatter validation script run or its command shown before declaring done

checklist.name: Review handoff offered
checklist.description: plan-review offered as the next step
